marks.gloss_en: זאת אומרת (variant) -- inferred from R' Yehuda's obligating even after division, on the within-thirty reading

R' Yirmeya (variant): two Yosef ben Shimon in one city, one of whom bought a field from the other: the creditor collects from him, for he says: if my claim is on you I take your share; if on your fellow, it was mortgaged to me before you [bought it]
אלמא: חמש ולא חצי חמש סבירא ליה -- since R' Yehuda requires ten zuz of inheritance each, he holds five and not half of five
rather, obviously: ten zuz of inheritance for this one and ten zuz of inheritance for that one
אי הכי, רבי יהודה אומר נתחייבו נכסים -- נתחייב גברא מיבעי ליה: on Rava's framing R' Yehuda should have said the man became obligated
ועוד תניא: R' Yehuda -- ten zuz for each, obligated; read at 48b.4-5 as ten zuz of inheritance each, so אלמא R' Yehuda holds five and not half of five
the baraita, R' Yehuda: brothers who divided -- if there are ten zuz for this one and ten zuz for that one, they are obligated; if not, exempt
מכלל דרבי מאיר סבר כי חלקו פטורין? הא אישתעבדו להו נכסי
(variant, on R' Yehuda's clause) the father died after thirty days
וכולה כלישנא קמא -- the rest as the first version, including Rava's לעולם לאחר שלשים, only five sela (48a.7)
מכדי נכסוהי דבר איניש אינון ערבין ביה -- וכולה כלישנא קמא
כי חלקו, אמאי מחייב רבי יהודה? ליזיל לגבי האי לידחייה, וגבי האי ולידחייה
(variant) the father died within thirty days
Rav Pappa: an oral loan is collected from the heirs and not from the purchasers
Rava: and here they dispute over 'five and not half of five'
(entertained) the ten zuz each are of inheritance and purchase together, and [R' Yehuda holds] five and even half of five
rather, everyone holds five and not half of five, and here they dispute over [the dicta of] Rav Asi and Rav Pappa
one [wife] had given birth before and one had not, and they bore two males -- he gives five sela'im to the kohen
the father died and the sons are alive -- R' Meir: if they gave before they divided [the estate], it is given; if not, they are exempt
two wives of two men, neither of whom had given birth, bore two males -- this one gives five sela'im to the kohen and that one gives five sela'im
a male and a female -- the fathers are exempt, and the son is obligated to redeem himself
one had given birth and one had not, of two men, and they bore two males -- the one whose wife had not given birth gives five sela'im to the kohen
כהן אחד נמי ליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה, וליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה -- with one kohen too, let him push off this one and push off that one
with two kohanim [they cannot extract] because he goes to this one and he pushes him off, and goes to that one and he pushes him off
two wives who had not given birth before bore two males: he gives ten sela to the priest
a male and a female, or two males and a female: he gives five sela to the priest
